title: Pediatric Oncology and Palliative Medicine Team Development Working Package 1
summary:
The study "Onkologisch palliativmediznische Teamentwicklung (OnkoPaTe)" (=Team Development of Oncologic Programms and Palliative Care Teams" intends to the improvement of care for children with life limiting cancer. New treatments as antibodies, cell-therapy or new drugs might have an delaying influence on the time point of involving palliative care teams. The palliative home care does not contradict the oncologic treatments. But a hand in hand of palliative care and oncology could raise duration of the patients time at home. And time is mandatory to improve trust to the palliative care team to stabilize the last phase of the incurable disease and reduce the symptom burden. 
Working-Package 1 (WP 1) of the OnkoPaTe study analyze the hospital as place of death of the children with cancer. DRG Data were evaluated of the "Statistisches Bundesamt" (= German Federal Statistic Office) of the years 2005 - 2020. All children (0 - 19 years) who were deceased of or with cancer were included. Variables are age, gender, diagnoses and medical procedures - especially treatment of intensive care units.
conditions: All life-threatening hematoma-oncological diseases in childhood

interventions.name: Retrospektive analysis of micro-data of the statistics of the diagnoses related groups system 2005 - 2020. Only deceased patients are analyzed. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Children and adolescents (max. 19 years old)
Deceased in a German hospital with a malignant disease
Main diagnose or secondary diagnose with "C" (ICD10) or diagnoses as D60.1, D60.8. D60.9, D61.0, D61.10, D61.18, D61.19, D61.3, D61.8, D61.9
Existence of a DRG dataset at the German Statistical Office
Exclusion criteria:
Age > 19 years
